fra-baidu-2.webp.zh: 法兰克福机场的 The Squaire 大楼：白色长弧造型的办公与酒店建筑横跨在铁路线上，支柱落在高速公路旁。
fra-baidu-2.webp.en: The Squaire at Frankfurt Airport — the long white curved building straddling the rail lines on its angled supports, the motorway running past.

fra-baidu-3.webp.zh: 空中俯瞰法兰克福机场：停机坪与跑道之间散布着正在作业的飞机与工程车辆，远处是法兰克福的城市天际线。
fra-baidu-3.webp.en: Frankfurt from the air — aircraft and construction traffic scattered across the apron and runways, the city skyline beyond the forest belt.
